title: of Ternovo
(Lysko)
name: Nazarius, Gervasius, Protasius and Celsus
venerable mother Parasceva
hieromartyr Roman
troparia: (Tone 4) This quartet of martyrs illumines the Church* like a brilliant star in the sky.* By the suffering of Nazarius and confession of the others,* the Church has been made to sing:* Glory to God, the strength of martyrs!
